schema: N3 live evaluated geometry audit v1

units.convention: Source model values interpreted as meters; table outputs millimeters. World Z=0 is nominal design floor. Actual context floor top measured separately.

method.frames: Every integer N1 operating frame 1..1920 at 24 fps
method.static: Evaluated mesh vertices at frame 1, with matrix_world applied; no builder or historic report values substituted.
method.section_centerline: Centroid of each 28-vertex outer sweep ring, 37 rings/section, reconstructed from evaluated saved mesh; 36-segment arc sum.
method.reach: Euclidean chord from proximal upper-cover ring centroid to evaluated glove-rig origin (modeled wrist datum).
method.clearance: Radial vertex/centerline distance to nominal infinite cylinder r=275mm; separate 71mm swept-radius proxy. Vertex samples are not triangle collision or loaded clearance.
method.scope: Prescribed geometry only; no pressure dynamics, forces, loaded travel, tolerances or impact qualification.

limitations: Nominal body cylinder excludes seams, overlaps, displaced fill/padding and collision between other parts.
All integer frames checked; subframes and continuous extrema are not bounded.
8 chambers per arm is an inventory count, not proof of controllability.
No manufacturing tolerance, density, rated pressure, force or durability inferred.
